title: Filters
description: Learn about action filters, authorization filters, and global filters in ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: This module covers filters in ASP.NET Core, which allow you to run code before or after specific stages in the request pipeline. You will learn about different filter types, dependency injection in filters, global filters, and the order of filter execution.
whatYouLearn: Understand what filters are and when to use them
Create and apply action filters, authorization filters, and exception filters
Configure global filters for application-wide behavior
Control the order of filter execution
